decisionQuestions: What carries brand identity across contexts: a color, a palette, or a multicolor mark?
Which colors dominate the interface system in relevant page contexts?
Which semantic treatment does a primary action use by surface and state?
How far may each finding map into the target design system?

decisionSequence.title: 分清角色
decisionSequence.question: 看到的是品牌标志、界面色系、行动样式，还是目标 token？
decisionSequence.rule: 分成不同判断。多色标志无需硬选一个色值，也不代表界面色系无法判断。

decisionSequence.title: 比较来源
decisionSequence.question: 哪些独立的品牌入口和任务页面在什么背景、状态使用了它？
decisionSequence.rule: 记录实际绘制值、页面、区域、用途和状态；CSS 声明、Logo 像素、宣传图和可见控件分池统计。

decisionSequence.title: 判断体系
decisionSequence.question: 单色、成对配色，还是随背景反转，哪种解释最符合观察？
decisionSequence.rule: 先比页面覆盖与职责，再比显著度和同职责频次。色系可以是双颜色，不跨任务投票，也不强迫只剩一个 hex。
decisionSequence.output: 身份、界面与行动体系的分项结论

decisionSequence.title: 处理例外
decisionSequence.question: 冲突来自同一职责，还是另一站点、活动、背景或任务？
decisionSequence.rule: 说明每个冲突，把局部例外留在最窄范围；解释不了的同职责冲突阻断更广的结论。

decisionSequence.title: 映射验收
decisionSequence.question: 目标设计系统的哪个语义 token 能接，尚缺什么证明？
decisionSequence.rule: 色系判断不等于 token 批准。检查语义、默认／悬停／焦点、对比度和真实渲染，独立视觉复核后才讨论全局复用。
decisionSequence.output: 获批范围或未映射候选

sourceStrategy.identityPriority: Start with current identity-bearing pages such as the official homepage and core brand entry, then compare at least one independent core page; an event-specific home section is not automatically global.
sourceStrategy.actionPriority: Compare controls doing the same primary-action job on the target task page and other relevant pages; do not substitute a campaign CTA or database Search for another role without a documented match.
sourceStrategy.minimumForGlobal: At least two independent relevant page contexts including a current identity-bearing source for brand-primary, plus observed states and no unresolved conflict. Counts are a floor, not a vote or automatic approval.

frequencyMethod.unit: visible controls doing a recorded semantic job, counted per independent page and state; inspect the actually painted child/background layer and text layer, not just the transparent outer button; do not count raw CSS declarations or repeated carousel clones
exclude: footer utility controls from the content-CTA denominator only after recording them separately
campaign imagery and card artwork from UI token counts
frequencyMethod.reviewOrder: First compare page authority and task role, then page coverage, visible prominence and within-role frequency; inspect hover/focus and contrast before approval.

evidenceHandoff.aggregateVsControl: A per-page frequency total is a sampling summary, not proof that every counted control has a retained selector. Preserve at least one independently re-checkable painted control per core page with URL, selector, nonempty region, default state, actual background and foreground; state clearly how many counted controls lack individual proof.
evidenceHandoff.scopeSeparation: A frozen goal for a two-dimension diagnostic can pass its own structural handoff while the original six-dimension learn-brand goal remains blocked. Both goal IDs and statuses must be shown together; a scoped PASS never inherits or replaces full-brand approval.
evidenceHandoff.versionRule: Evidence and Interpreter records must name the same frozen goal version they answer. A previous PASS with a different goal ID cannot approve a new packet.
evidenceHandoff.trialLineage: A reversible before/after trial reads candidate values from the versioned Interpreter output and names the unchanged task, viewport and content. A visible difference proves only that the candidate rendered, not that its target token or aesthetic outcome is approved.

defaultHypothesis: A primary action normally starts from the design system's semantic primary-action role, but whether its value equals the brand identity primary color is a separate evidence-backed decision.
exceptionRule: A CTA color or treatment that differs from brand-primary may be approved only at the narrowest supported scope after same-role cross-page and state comparison; a local campaign or tool-page exception is never silently global.
fallback: When evidence is incomplete, keep the target's existing semantic primary-action token and mark brand value unresolved; do not assign a sampled hex or RGB value as global primary.
